description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling FAQ-related web requests, including listing FAQs and generating URLs for editing FAQs in an admin interface.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::FAQ
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class for FAQ pages, extending Coocook::Controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests for the FAQ page, retrieves FAQs from the database, and prepares data for rendering, including admin URLs if the user has permissions.
